description: Create or resize the Sim Farm. `create` makes a template sim from an app build and, optionally, a seed folder (signed-in app data); clones are made from it in about 4 s each. Dev-client apps (Expo) need `launchUrl` so they open on Metro instead of the launcher. `grow` / `shrink` change how many sims exist. Use `dryRun` first: it returns the plan, what slim mode turns off (push, StoreKit, app links, widgets, Spotlight…) and whether the Mac has room. You own the pool: Buoy Desktop has no size control. sim_farm_acquire makes sims as needed; `shrink` the ones you no longer need so they stop using disk space.

appPath.description: For create: path to a simulator .app build.

count.description: For grow/shrink: how many sims to add or remove.

deviceType.description: For create: a simctl device type id. Default iPhone 17 Pro.

dryRun.description: Return the plan and its cost without changing anything.

launchUrl.description: For create: URL opened after each launch, e.g. exp+my-app://expo-development-client/?url=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A8081.

metroPort.description: For create: the Metro port the app loads from. Default 8802.

mode.description: create = new template; grow/shrink = pool size.

requestId.description: Any unique string for this call. Repeating the same call with the same requestId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

runtime.description: For create: a simctl runtime id. Default iOS 26.3.

seedDir.description: For create: seed folder (Documents/, AsyncStorage/, Preferences/, seed.json). null = no seed.

templateId.description: For grow/shrink. Defaults to the newest usable template.

name: sim_farm_setup
